summary: Receipt email shows the ride date in UTC
description: Steps: finish a ride, wait for the receipt email. Expected: the timestamp shown matches the rider's local time, same as the app. Actual: the receipt prints the ride's start and end time in UTC, which confuses riders checking their statement against what the app showed them.

comments.author: dana.whitlock
comments.body: Easy fix on the receipt template -- swapping the formatter should sort it before the next release window.
